headline: The radio left between stations.
body: A voice almost arrives, then falls back into grain. On the sill the plant leans toward the glass and does not quite touch it. Someone set a cup down and walked out with the spoon still in it.

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: a bicycle chained to the wrong post

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the kettle cooling on its own
